title: Impresso bounding box
description: Rectangular region in a two-dimensional media coordinate space. The bounding box is represented as `[x, y, width, height]`, where `x` and `y` are the coordinates of the upper-left corner and `width` and `height` are the dimensions of the rectangle. Coordinates and dimensions are expressed in pixels.

prefixItems.description: Horizontal coordinate of the upper-left corner.
Vertical coordinate of the upper-left corner.
